headline: AMBA Stock Rockets 18% On NXP Buyout Talks For Self-Driving Chip Maker
summary: NXP, the Netherlands-based large chipmaker, is reportedly discussing an acquisition of Ambarella, the San Francisco-based designer of AI-powered chips used in cameras for self-driving cars and security systems.
